mapper.select: SELECT pb.id AS browseId, pb.product_id AS productId, pb.create_time AS createTime, p.product_name AS productName, p.pic AS pic, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM pms_product_browse pb LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN pms_category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE pb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pb.create_time DESC

SELECT pb.id AS browse_id, pb.product_id, pb.create_time, p.product_name, p.pic, s.id AS sku_id, s.price, s.sku_code FROM pms_product_browse pb LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN pms_sku s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE pb.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pb.create_time DESC
